_comment: D-PLY-64 (2026-11-06): what an owner-claim instance token is. Each Service object draws one
(Model.playerOwnerToken) and passes it on every verb that claims the player (in OMARCHY_IPTV_ARGS)
and on its orphan check (on that check's argv: execDetached starts only a command list). Run by Model.isOwnerToken, which decides whether a builder passes
--owner-token at all (tests/Model.test.js), and by the helper's is_owner_token, behind
owner_token_arg, which refuses any other value on the command line (tests/test_player.py). The two
must agree, or a token the shell passes is refused and every start fails. `valid` are tokens;
`invalid` are not, and neither side may accept one. ASCII only.
